notes.title: KnifePlayground is an Unreal horror royale with bodycam combat, demon clowns and a shapeshifting mansion
notes.notes:
Let's get this out of the way first: KnifePlayground: Horror Battle Royale is an absolutely terrible name for game. You might as well call Halo "GunMap: Alien Crowd Control", or Baldur's Gate 3 "TownDungeon: Party Enhancement Simulator". But the project beneath the moniker has something to it. Announced just today and created by small Brazilian team MadMozer, it's a first-person, multiplayer-focussed, Unreal Engine deathgame that traps you in a randomly generated mansion with a bunch of archetypal horror movie munsters - demon clowns, cursed puppets, toothy ghouls and hooded axe-murderers.

notes.notes:
[i][b]Hello World![/b] [/i]

We have finally released our Steam page after a lot of work! ːsteamthisː

Let's introduce ourselves. 

We're MadMozer, a small indie team from Brazil, and we're very happy to start this campaign. 

KnifePlayground is our first big and mature project, and after years of learning and experience, we have a well-prepared team to face all the challenges ahead.

So, I welcome you to our community, and let's create a freaking awesome action horror game with your precious feedback.

[i]Stay tuned for more news about the game's development. Take care![/i] ːsteamthumbsupː

[i]- Leonardo. [/i]
